title: Magnetic radius calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates r = mv₀/(qB) = 0.2 m.

title: Exit coordinate from O
description: Essential: Student finds y_A = R²/(2r) = 0.025 m for particle incident from origin.

title: Incidence coordinate
description: Essential: Student finds y_D' = -(r - r cos30°) ≈ -0.027 m.

title: Geometry of circular arc
description: Important: Student recognizes particles follow circular arcs with radius r > R.

title: Maximum angle derivation
description: Important: Student determines maximum central angle α_m = π/6 from geometry.

title: Period calculation
description: Optional: Student computes full period T = 2πm/(qB) correctly.

title: Sign error in coordinates
description: Pitfall: Student uses wrong sign for y_D' (positive instead of negative).

title: Confusing radius relationships
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assumes r = R or misapplies geometry for y_A.
